# CodesbyFebin

> Febin Francis: systems engineering, AI infrastructure, verifiable compute, Kerala, India.

These are source-linked engineering notes. Proposed checks are not reported test results. Repository descriptions are a 3 October 2026 snapshot.

## Core pages
- [Febin Francis — systems engineer and open-source builder](https://codesbyfebin.github.io/): Febin Francis builds AI infrastructure, verifiable compute, and sovereign systems. Explore source-linked projects and practical engineering field notes.
- [About Febin Francis](https://codesbyfebin.github.io/about/): Systems engineering from Kerala, India. I build around three questions: what was intended, what actually ran, and what evidence survives. My focus.
- [Systems and architecture](https://codesbyfebin.github.io/systems/): Control planes, worker runtimes, and proof boundaries. A control plane expresses intent and governs permissions. A runtime produces observed effects. An.
- [Research notes](https://codesbyfebin.github.io/research/): Questions that connect verifiable compute and agent infrastructure. These notes are engineering investigations rather than journal publications. The.
- [Specifications and contracts](https://codesbyfebin.github.io/specifications/): Define what a system is allowed to claim. A useful contract names inputs, outputs, limits, permissions, and completion criteria. It states what happens.
- [Open-source contributions](https://codesbyfebin.github.io/contributions/): Inspect repositories rather than invented event histories. The supplied sources contain project records and technical writing. They do not substantiate.
- [GitHub and source identity](https://codesbyfebin.github.io/github/): The source is part of the explanation. Use the GitHub profile to inspect repositories, histories, and contribution records. Star counts and activity are.
- [Working together](https://codesbyfebin.github.io/services/): Systems architecture, AI infrastructure, and technical review. My work focuses on clear interfaces, observable execution, and reviewable technical.
- [Contact Febin Francis](https://codesbyfebin.github.io/contact/): Start with the system and the outcome you need. Use my public profiles to start a conversation. Include the repository or system, current behavior,.
- [Editorial method and evidence scope](https://codesbyfebin.github.io/methodology/): Source-linked explanations with explicit limits. This portfolio merges 100 supplied workspace article drafts with seven new guides adapted from the.
- [Privacy](https://codesbyfebin.github.io/privacy/): A static site with browser-local preferences. The generated site has no analytics, tracking pixels, authentication, comments backend, or contact form..
